title: Causal Time Series Modeling of Supraglacial Lake Evolution in Greenland under Distribution Shift
abstract: arXiv:2510.15265v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Causal modeling offers a principled foundation for uncovering stable, invariant relationships in time-series data, thereby improving robustness and generalization under distribution shifts. Yet its potential is underutilized in spatiotemporal Earth observation, where models often depend on purely correlational features that fail to transfer across heterogeneous domains. We propose RIC-TSC, a regionally-informed causal time-series classification framework that embeds lag-aware causal discovery directly into sequence modeling, enabling both predictive accuracy and scientific interpretability. Using multi-modal satellite and reanalysis data-including Sentinel-1 microwave backscatter, Sentinel-2 and Landsat-8 optical reflectance, and CARRA meteorological variables-we leverage Joint PCMCI+ (J-PCMCI+) to identify region-specific and invariant predictors of supraglacial lake evolution in Greenland. translated_title: 分布偏移下格陵兰冰面湖演化的因果时间序列建模
translated_abstract: 因果建模为揭示时间序列数据中稳定、不变的关系提供了有原则的基础，从而在分布偏移下提升鲁棒性和泛化能力。然而，其潜力在时空地球观测领域尚未得到充分利用，因为模型往往依赖于纯相关性特征，而这些特征难以在异构域之间迁移。我们提出了RIC-TSC，一个区域感知的因果时间序列分类框架，它将滞后感知的因果发现直接嵌入到序列建模中，同时实现预测准确性与科学可解释性。利用多模态卫星与再分析数据——包括Sentinel-1微波后向散射、Sentinel-2和Landsat-8光学反射率以及CARRA气象变量——我们借助联合PCMCI+（J-PCMCI+）方法识别格陵兰冰面湖演化的区域特定预测因子和不变预测因子。因果图在全局和每个区域尺度上进行估计
tldr: 该论文提出区域感知的因果时间序列分类框架RIC-TSC，将滞后感知的因果发现嵌入序列建模，并利用多模态卫星与再分析数据识别格陵兰冰面湖演化的区域特定与不变预测因子，从而在分布偏移下兼顾预测准确性与科学可解释性。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes RIC-TSC, a regionally-informed causal time-series classification framework that embeds lag-aware causal discovery into sequence modeling and uses multi-modal satellite and reanalysis data to identify region-specific and invariant predictors of supraglacial lake evolution in Greenland, achieving both predictive accuracy and scientific interpretability under distribution shift.
